name: PHP2Shell
summary: Two flaws in the PHP interpreter that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution: memory corruption during out-of-memory handling (CVE-2026-109618), and a use-after-free involving state kept between requests (CVE-2026-109619).
end_of_life_note: End-of-life branches get no official release. The PHP security team published minimal source backports for 7.4; any other end-of-life branch needs an upgrade to a supported branch.
exploitation: Exploitation attempts were reported around disclosure (AWS, SecurityWeek); Unit 42 retracted its exploitation claim on 2026-10-25. Treat it as urgent either way.
